notes: Background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Heavy real-time session analysis and agent-style assistant in product UI.
Initial ask: want hosted for fast ramp, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation as usage grows.
Latency/throughput targets: 95p < 150ms (in-region), initial throughput target ~60-100 reqs/sec across 3 main endpoints (chat/embeddings/rerank).
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Finance expects demo POC cost <= $8k for 30-day test; long-term target unit cost reduction >30% vs current cloud endpoints.

Model prefs: prefer open models (Llama/Redwood-verified variants) but willing to test smaller quantized variants for cost-sensitive paths. Want auto-fallback rules to smaller models for non-critical routes.

Routing/fallback needs: per-route policy; chat latency-sensitive -> premium pool; batch embeddings -> lower-cost GPU pool; automatic fallback to quantized variant on Dedicated if cold-starts detected.
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO + SCIM for provisioning, KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated/Private, audit logs for token-level billing and evals.
Demo/POC plan so far:
- 2026-01-18: Discovery call (Riley + Elena) — high-level requirements capture. Client sent sample prompts and dataset (10k docs).
- 2026-02-02: Hosted API demo (Elena) — showed chat & embeddings latency, streaming. Masthead liked streaming but asked for lower token cost paths.
- 2026-02-22: Price sensitivity call (Riley + Finance) — asked for committed & burst pricing for Dedicated. Procurement wants ARR floor for Dedicated proposal.
- 2026-03-01: Security questionnaire returned (SEC-1073) — pending KMS details and data residency confirmation for EU customers.

- 2026-03-09: Deep-dive call with engineering (Elena + Masthead infra + Marco) — discussed batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization profiles. Live latency tests on hosted showed p95 ~170ms on worst-case long-context prompts.
Cost optimization workshop output (prelim):
- Batching: suggested continuous batching for embeddings and rerank; target batch sizing to hit 60-70% GPU utilization during daily spikes. Projected 20-30% token-cost reduction.
- Caching: implement prefix/KV cache for 40% of chat traffic (welcome flows & help center queries). Expected latency cut for cache-hits to <50ms and cost reduction for hot-prefix reuse.

- Quantization profiles: trial q4_8 and q5_0 for rerank/embeddings workloads on Dedicated; maintain fp16 variants for latency-sensitive chat. Estimate 2.5x cost decrease per token for quantized rerank runs with acceptable quality delta.

- Unit economics model: built sample calc for 1M monthly tokens across routes; showed switching rerank -> quantized reduces infra cost by ~$1.8k/mo; combined batching/caching could save ~35% total monthly spend.
Client quotes & signals:
- CTO (A. Singh): 'We need a predictable bill we can model into our PLG motion — show us the committed vs burst math.'
- Head of Product (M. Alvarez): 'Embedding cost is the current blocker for search — curious if cache + quantization keeps quality.'
POC specifics requested by Masthead (agreed during 2026-03-09):
- 30-day POC on Hosted with traffic mirror + sample production traffic (50k queries/day) — measure latency, token spend, cache-hit rate.
- Parallel Dedicated cost estimate and capacity plan for baseline 100 qps steady-state with 3x spikes. Include committed vs burst pricing options.
- Run AB quality comparison for rerank: fp16 baseline vs q4_8 quantized variant on 5k labeled queries.
Next actions / owner list:
- Riley: finalize Dedicated pricing options and ARR floor (due 2026-03-15).
- Elena (SE): deliver POC config & Jenkins-style load scripts; provide batch/caching knobs and recommended quant profiles (due 2026-03-17).
- Marco (CSM): prep onboarding checklist and compliance packet for SOC2/KMS details; coordinate EU residency confirmation with infra team (due 2026-03-18).
- Masthead: agree target POC dataset (5k rerank labels + 10k doc corpus) and sign POC terms (POC cost cap $8k).
Open concerns flagged in call:
- Need clearer SLA language around fallback model quality regression and automated rollover to hosted during Dedicated outages.
- Procurement pushback: committed spend vs optional burst pricing — wants trial-to-prod uplift guardrails.
- Measuring true end-user latency (client-side rendering included) — Masthead asked for instrumentation guidance from Redwood.

Summary/feel: Very engaged product team, pragmatic about staged adoption (hosted -> dedicated). Primary negotiation point will be committed pricing and demonstrable unit economics from the cost workshop. Good fit for Redwood Optimize + Dedicated if we can show 30%+ cost reduction without breaking quality for reranking and embeddings.
